models.notes: Arabic-STT best-grpo2: task06 + 0.3 x (run20 - task06), then GRPO (LoRA r 16, merged; 935 steps) on human-annotated Arabic customer-service call segments, English call-centre clips, quiet short answers under a louder turn, joined multi-turn pieces and windows without speech; weights gated on the Hub. Carries its parents' in-domain train rows (run 5's, MGB-3 train and the 20 leaked FLEURS ar_eg test sentences included)

Arabic-STT best-task06: task-arithmetic merge run6b + 0.6 x (run10 - run6b) + 0.6 x (avg - run6b), avg the 0.5/0.5 average of run6b-soup70-sip-v5 and sip-v5-grpo1, no further training (merge weights picked on the Audioluna calls); weights gated on the Hub. Every parent carries run 5's in-domain train rows (MGB-3 train and the 20 leaked FLEURS ar_eg test sentences included); sip-v5 adds an MGB-2 part of kejue-voice, sip-v5-grpo1 EdAcc and Earnings-22 (English)

Arabic-STT round 20, S7all step 1000 + 1,000 MWER steps (the card's pick with its levelling front end and MBR decoding); tag `run20-mwer-s1000` of Arabic-STT/qwen3-asr-1.7b-ar-run20 (commit ae7e8163ce), weights gated on the Hub. Online RL (RLOO) from run16-soup on English call windows, far-end mixes (AMI, ICSI, HarperValleyBank, PriMock57), Arabic phone-call windows and synthetic TTS turns; carries the run9 line's in-domain train rows

Arabic-STT round 20 (the same weights as tag run20-mwer-s800 of Arabic-STT/qwen3-asr-1.7b-ar-run20): online RL (RLOO) from run16-soup on English call windows, far-end mixes (AMI, ICSI, HarperValleyBank, PriMock57), Arabic phone-call windows and synthetic TTS turns, then 800 steps of MWER; weights gated on the Hub.
